sentinel: SUCCESS:WFA-0111 in the receipt AND a fitted operator-selection policy whose held-out exact-match rate beats a published random-operator baseline, with NOT-FUSIBLE recorded as a valid outcome and fit inputs on disk so the policy can be refitted
title: Policy deciding which of the seven operators to apply to a given pair
question: Implementation target: a written policy mapping a source pair's measured properties — overlap ratio, conflict presence, benchmark separation, cost asymmetry — to the operator most likely to produce a certified result, so operator choice is reproducible rather than improvised per pair.

corpus.split_rule: sha256(feature-tuple)[:8] % 5 == 0 => held_out; licence clones j>=9 => held_out (3 of 12)

random_baseline.note: Random never selects NOT-FUSIBLE. A pair for which no operator certifies therefore scores 0 under the baseline and 1 under a policy that reports NOT-FUSIBLE.

evidence.claim: Policy fitted on 297 train pairs was applied to 65 held-out pairs. Exact match against the operator that actually certified is 0.815385 (53/65).
Uniform random over the seven operators has expected exact-match 0.134066 on the same held-out golds (Monte Carlo 0.134262, seed 2111). Policy margin over expected random is 0.681319.
18 corpus pairs certify under no operator and are recorded as NOT-FUSIBLE; 4 of those are held-out. NOT-FUSIBLE is a valid policy outcome.

Fit inputs are command-center/p2-wave/probes/WFA-0111/fixtures/pairs.json (features + certified labels + split). engine.fit_policy majority-votes feature bins; refitting is python3 -B emit.py after editing that file.

reviewer.lens: Recomputes the random baseline on a second code path, requires invert-policy not to beat random, and plants conflict/licence mutations that must flip the policy (both-states).

notes: Upstream WFA-0100..0107 artifacts are absent on this worktree. Certification labels are produced by a catalog-semantics oracle (LEGAL/ILLEGAL plus per-operator certify margins), not by running missing fusion binaries. The policy is fitted only on the train split and evaluated on held-out pairs against that oracle. A policy that did not beat random would not have been shipped. SUCCESS:WFA-0111
